root_cause: The canonical SEO conversion annotator used a case-insensitive single-match regex and therefore tagged only the first in-content anchor pointing to the primary CTA. The delegated growth tracker emitted primary_cta_click only for statically tagged anchors, ignoring dynamic first-party, in-content links to selfscan, Frisse Blik and checkout. One recorded primary CTA event in 28 days is a signal of insufficient tracking, not proof that nobody clicked: ingestion/delivery may also be incomplete.
fix: Annotate every in-content primary CTA anchor, preserve header/mobile/footer byte-for-byte, use narrowly allowlisted delegated first-party fallback for dynamic untagged /zelfscan, /frisse-blik and /afsluiten links inside main. Reuse existing first-party /api/growth-event, no new collector, cookie, session identity, customer PII or analytics store.
prevention_rule: All declared in-content conversion CTAs must be measured once including repeated, mobile/content and dynamically rendered anchors, while cross-site and global shell links do not become primary conversions; sampled event counts are not customer or revenue evidence.

invariants: dynamic same-site main CTAs measured once
real measured conversion and production readback required
